MiniMaxH3SpeedCache.description: Dedicated SageAttention and safe residual-cache acceleration for MiniMax H3, with automatic fallback to ComfyUI's default attention backend.

model.name: MiniMax H3 Model
model.tooltip: Connect the MODEL output of a MiniMax H3 model loader. Only MiniMaxH3Model is supported; image models and other video models are rejected. This input has no numeric range or default model.

reuse_threshold.name: ★ Reuse Threshold
reuse_threshold.tooltip: CORE SPEED/QUALITY CONTROL. Reuse a cached Transformer residual when accumulated feature change is below this value. Default: 0.12; range: 0.00–1.00; step: 0.005. Higher values can skip more work and run faster, but increase risks to fine detail, motion continuity, and audio/video consistency. At 0.00 no steps are skipped. Try 0.06–0.08 for quality, 0.10 for balance, or 0.12 for the tested default profile.

start_percent.name: ★ Acceleration Start
start_percent.tooltip: CORE SAMPLING WINDOW CONTROL. The sampling progress at which cache reuse may start. Default: 0.10 (10%); range: 0.00–1.00; step: 0.01. Starting earlier may improve speed but can affect structure and motion because early sampling changes rapidly. Must be lower than Acceleration End.

end_percent.name: ★ Acceleration End
end_percent.tooltip: CORE SAMPLING WINDOW CONTROL. Cache reuse stops after this sampling progress so final steps run fully and refine detail. Default: 0.90 (90%); range: 0.00–1.00; step: 0.01. Ending later may be faster but increases risk to texture, edges, motion, and audio detail. Must be higher than Acceleration Start.

max_consecutive_skips.name: ★ Maximum Consecutive Skips
max_consecutive_skips.tooltip: CORE SAFETY LIMIT. Maximum number of consecutive cache reuses before one full Transformer pass is forced. Default: 2; range: 1–5; step: 1. Higher values may be faster but noticeably increase motion, subject-stability, and audio-sync risks. Use 1 for quality; the tested default is 2; values above 2 are not recommended without comparison tests.

cache_device.name: Cache Device
cache_device.tooltip: Where the large residual cache is stored. Default: auto. auto selects GPU or CPU from actual free memory and the configured reserves (recommended). gpu is normally fastest but consumes more VRAM. cpu saves VRAM but must transfer the residual back to the GPU and may be slower.

sage_attention.name: ★ Automatic SageAttention
sage_attention.tooltip: Default auto: use SageAttention for the MiniMax H3 diffusion model when available, with automatic fallback to ComfyUI's default attention backend and no separate Sage node required. enabled requires SageAttention and raises an error if unavailable. disabled leaves attention unchanged.

vram_reserve_gb.name: VRAM Reserve (GB)
vram_reserve_gb.tooltip: VRAM that auto mode must leave available for model weights, activations, CUDA workspace, and VAE. Default: 2.0 GB; range: 0.5–16.0 GB; step: 0.5 GB. Increase this after out-of-memory errors; reduce it only when VRAM is plentiful. This setting does not change physical VRAM or GPU power.

ram_reserve_gb.name: System RAM Reserve (GB)
ram_reserve_gb.tooltip: System memory that auto mode must leave available before choosing CPU cache. Default: 4.0 GB; range: 1.0–32.0 GB; step: 1.0 GB. Increase it when memory is tight, other applications are running, or you want to avoid paging.

signature_tokens.name: Signature Tokens
signature_tokens.tooltip: Number of sampled audio/video hidden-state positions used for change detection. Default: 128; range: 32–512; step: 32. Higher values inspect more positions but add a small detection cost; values that are too low may miss changes. This does not alter output resolution or frame count. Keep 128 unless testing.

signature_features.name: Signature Features
signature_features.tooltip: Hidden feature channels sampled at each signature position. Default: 64; range: 16–256; step: 16. Higher values make change detection more detailed with a small overhead; values that are too low can reduce reliability. This does not change model precision. Keep 64 unless testing.

verbose.name: Detailed Cache Log
verbose.tooltip: Print RUN/SKIP decisions for every step and a final summary with skipped passes, cache location, and estimated speedup. Default: off (False). Enable for the first comparison or troubleshooting; disable for routine use to reduce log noise.

0.name: Accelerated Model
0.tooltip: MiniMax H3 MODEL with the safe residual-cache policy applied. Connect it to the sampler in place of the original MODEL link.

MiniMaxH3CacheRuntimeOptions.display_name: MiniMax H3 Subgraph Cache Runtime Options
MiniMaxH3CacheRuntimeOptions.description: Overrides cache device and logging on an existing MiniMax H3 Speed Cache model without stacking a second cache.

model.name: Accelerated Model
model.tooltip: Purpose: receive a MODEL already patched by MiniMax H3 Speed Cache (Safe). No default, numeric bounds, or step. Connecting a raw UNETLoader model produces a clear error.

cache_device.name: Cache Device
cache_device.tooltip: Purpose: override cache storage for this run. Default auto; choices auto, gpu, or cpu; no numeric step. auto is recommended; gpu is usually fastest but uses VRAM; cpu saves VRAM but transfer can be slower.

verbose.name: Detailed Cache Log
verbose.tooltip: Purpose: override detailed logging for this run. Default off; choices on or off; no numeric bounds or step. Enable for RUN/SKIP, cache-device, and estimated-speedup diagnostics.

0.name: Model
0.tooltip: The same accelerated MiniMax H3 model with updated cache-device and logging options.

MiniMaxH3TextEncoderCache.description: Cache identical prompt and reference-image conditioning to avoid repeatedly running the 32B MiniMax H3 text encoder. The first encode still performs full computation.

clip.name: MiniMax H3 Text Encoder
clip.tooltip: Purpose: connect a CLIPLoader configured with type minimax and add exact-result caching. Only the MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL 32B text encoder is accepted. This connection has no default, numeric bounds, or step size.

cache_enabled.name: Enable Encoding Cache
cache_enabled.tooltip: Purpose: control prompt/reference encoding caching. Default: enabled; choices are enabled or disabled, with no numeric bounds or step size. Identical content is reused; any change triggers a normal full encode.

max_cache_entries.name: Maximum Cache Entries
max_cache_entries.tooltip: Purpose: limit retained encoding results. Default 2; minimum 1; maximum 8; step 1. Results are stored in system RAM. Higher values make switching between prompts faster but use more memory.

verbose.name: Detailed Text Cache Log
verbose.tooltip: Purpose: print text-cache HIT and MISS messages. Default: disabled; choices are enabled or disabled, with no numeric bounds or step size. Enable for diagnosis and leave disabled for normal use.

sage_attention.name: ★ QwenVL SageAttention 2.1.1
sage_attention.tooltip: Default auto: use the SageAttention 2.1.1 kernel interface for QwenVL vision and pure causal text attention, with safe PyTorch fallback for unsupported masks or kernels. enabled requires SageAttention; disabled keeps the native ComfyUI backend.

0.name: Cached Text Encoder
0.tooltip: Connect this to the MiniMax H3 conditioning node in place of the original CLIPLoader output.

LinjianMiniMaxH3ImageToVideo.description: Creates a native subgraph matching the built-in Image to Video (MiniMax H3), with unet_name changed to a MODEL socket for the MiniMax H3 Speed Cache output.

first_frame.name: first_frame
first_frame.tooltip: Optional first frame constraining the opening subject, composition, and style. Default unconnected; no numeric bounds or step. Large aspect-ratio differences may crop or scale the image.

last_frame.name: last_frame
last_frame.tooltip: Optional last frame constraining the ending and transition. Default unconnected; no numeric bounds or step. A large first/last-frame difference can reduce motion naturalness.

prompt.name: prompt
prompt.tooltip: Describes content, camera motion, action, environment, and sound. Uses the bundled Chinese prompt by default; no numeric bounds or step. Clear, non-conflicting instructions improve consistency.

width.name: width
width.tooltip: Output width. Default 1344; range 32–16384; step 32. Higher values can add detail but increase VRAM and runtime; use multiples of 32.

height.name: height
height.tooltip: Output height. Default 768; range 32–16384; step 32. Higher values can add detail but increase VRAM and runtime; use multiples of 32.

value_1.name: duration
value_1.tooltip: Video seconds converted to frames at 24 fps. Default 30 seconds; common 5–15 seconds; step 0.1 second. Runtime and memory grow strongly with duration; 30 seconds is about 736 frames.

steps.name: steps
steps.tooltip: BasicScheduler sampling steps. Default 20; range 1–10000; step 1. More steps increase runtime; too few can reduce detail and stability. Start with 20 for MiniMax H3.

noise_seed.name: noise_seed
noise_seed.tooltip: Initial-noise seed for reproducibility or variation. Default 28250570182816; range 0–18446744073709551615; step 1. Changing it alters composition, motion, and detail.

unet_name.name: unet_name
unet_name.tooltip: Requires a MODEL from MiniMax H3 Speed Cache (Safe). Default unconnected; no numeric bounds or step. Connect UNETLoader → Speed Cache → this socket; do not connect raw UNET directly.

cache_device.name: cache_device
cache_device.tooltip: Overrides the external cache device for this run. Default auto; choices auto, gpu, cpu; no numeric step. auto is recommended; gpu is faster but uses VRAM; cpu saves VRAM but transfer may slow generation.

verbose.name: verbose
verbose.tooltip: Overrides detailed cache logging. Default off; choices on or off; no numeric bounds or step. Enable for RUN/SKIP, device, and estimated-speedup diagnostics.

clip_name.name: clip_name
clip_name.tooltip: Selects the MiniMax H3 QwenVL text/vision encoder. Defaults to the Qwen3-VL 32B MiniMax H3 INT8 ConvRot file; no numeric bounds or step. Changing it reloads the encoder.

vae_name.name: vae_name
vae_name.tooltip: Selects the MiniMax H3 video VAE that decodes latent video frames. Defaults to minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors; no numeric bounds or step. A mismatched VAE can fail or alter colors.

vae_name_1.name: audio_vae
vae_name_1.tooltip: Selects the MiniMax H3 audio VAE that decodes latent audio. Defaults to minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors; no numeric bounds or step. A mismatch can produce silence or failure.

LinjianMiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.description: Built-in-compatible MiniMax H3 picture, video, and audio reference conditioning with an internal SageAttention 2.1.1 QwenVL adapter and safe PyTorch fallback.

clip.name: clip
clip.tooltip: Connect a CLIPLoader configured for MiniMax H3; QwenVL SageAttention 2.1.1 is applied automatically when compatible.

vae.name: vae
vae.tooltip: Connect the MiniMax H3 video VAE used to encode reference pictures and videos.

audio_vae.name: audio_vae
audio_vae.tooltip: Connect the MiniMax H3 audio VAE used to encode reference soundtracks and audio.

prompt.name: prompt
prompt.tooltip: Describe the output and reference connected media with <Picture i>, <Video k>, and <Audio j> tags.

width.name: width
width.tooltip: Output width. Default 1344; minimum 32; maximum is the ComfyUI resolution limit; step 32.

height.name: height
height.tooltip: Output height. Default 768; minimum 32; maximum is the ComfyUI resolution limit; step 32.

length.name: length
length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps. Default 124; range 5-3600; step 17; trained range is about 124-362.

ref_image_size.name: ref_image_size
ref_image_size.tooltip: Default match scales references to the output area. max uses the 2048px-short-edge reference path for stronger identity but can be much slower.

ref_image_0.name: ref_image_0
ref_image_0.tooltip: First reference picture; large pictures are downscaled and smaller pictures are not enlarged.

ref_image_1.name: ref_image_1
ref_image_1.tooltip: Second reference picture; large pictures are downscaled and smaller pictures are not enlarged.

ref_image_2.name: ref_image_2
ref_image_2.tooltip: Third reference picture; large pictures are downscaled and smaller pictures are not enlarged.

ref_video_0.name: ref_video_0
ref_video_0.tooltip: Reference video frames at 24 fps; use a 2-15 second clip.

ref_audio_0.name: ref_audio_0
ref_audio_0.tooltip: Standalone reference audio that is not tied to a video.

0.name: positive
0.tooltip: Positive conditioning carrying the MiniMax H3 reference payloads.

1.name: Latent
1.tooltip: Empty MiniMax H3 audio/video latent at the selected dimensions and length.
